text: The account hub replaces inline image sources with shared icon classes defined in widgets.css, as requested in review. The inspected markup combines an image class such as icon-success with an input-state class such as input-success, while the input and its error label keep their own validation association. Do not infer an image or severity contract from a class name alone; the fixed warning class uses the info image in this family. The 100ms discussion experiment was diagnostic, and later failures remained. No icon rendering, native timing or accessible-tree test ran.
title: Account hub status icons use shared image classes and separate input state
